title: A Winter for the Smile
author: Vesper Montrose
blurb: Isandro Zhou, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
